questions.question: Compare and contrast between impulse invariance method and bilinear transformation method. Design a digital IIR low pass filter using bilinear transformation based on Butterworth approximation to meet the following specifications: passband magnitude characteristics that is constant to within 1 dB for recurrences below $\omega = 0.2\pi$ and stopband attenuation of at least 15 dB for frequencies between $\omega = 0.3\pi$ and $\pi$. Use bilinear transformation.

questions.question:
Define Gibb's phenomenon. The desired frequency response of a HPF is given by
$$H_d(e^{j\omega}) = \begin{cases} e^{-j3\omega} & \omega_c \leq |\omega| \leq \pi \\ 0 & |\omega| < \omega_c \end{cases}$$
Design a linear phase FIR filter using hamming window for $M = 7$ and $\omega_c = 2$ rad/sample.

questions.question:
Compute the lattice-ladder coefficients for the given IIR system:
$$H(z) = \frac{1 + 2z^{-1} + 2z^{-2} + z^{-3}}{1 + \frac{13}{24}z^{-1} + \frac{5}{8}z^{-2} + \frac{1}{3}z^{-3}}$$
Also, comment on the stability and draw the lattice-ladder structure for the system.
